title: The Broken Recipe
premise: Dominic Voss, a scholarship student at Ashgrove Academy, has spent two years staying invisible — until the school's legendary ghost begins leaving him handwritten notes in ink that shouldn't exist. The notes lead him to a hidden archive proving the school board covered up a student's death decades ago, a cover-up that quietly continues today through rigged scholarships and silenced families. As Dominic and his unlikely allies dig deeper, he must choose between the safe future his scholarship represents and the justice the ghost demands. In the end, Dominic exposes the truth at graduation itself, the board falls, and he discovers the 'ghost' is a living guardian of the buried past who finally gets to rest.
about_author: Rafael Whitlock is the pen name of a former boarding-school teacher who spent years collecting the whispered legends of old academic institutions. They write young adult mysteries about ordinary students forced to confront extraordinary secrets.

chapters.title: The Locker That Wasn't His
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Establishing his careful invisibility at Ashgrove Academy: scholarship rules, social hierarchies, and his single goal of graduating debt-free. He finds the first note inside his locker — his full name, written in ink that shimmers and won't smudge. Emotional beat: unease beneath routine; the safe walls of his world develop their first crack.

chapters.title: Ink That Remembers
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV, with a brief interlude from his roommate Theo's perspective. Dominic tests the note's impossible properties while researching the academy's founding ghost story, 'the Archivist.' A second note appears, referencing something only Dominic knows. Emotional beat: curiosity overtaking fear as the mystery becomes personal.

chapters.title: Rules of the Scholarship
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Headmaster Crane summons him, warning about 'distractions' — a veiled threat wrapped in kindness. Dominic realizes someone powerful knows about the notes. He meets Marisol Reyes, a board member's daughter who despises her family's legacy. Emotional beat: first taste of surveillance and duty pulling against each other.

chapters.title: The Archive Beneath the Chapel
chapters.summary: Alternating POV between Dominic and Marisol. Following the third note's riddle, they discover a sealed sub-basement containing decades of confiscated records. Among them: the 1974 file of Elian Marsh, a scholarship student who died on campus. Emotional beat: awe curdling into dread as the scale of the burial becomes clear.

chapters.title: What Elian Knew
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. The notes grow more urgent, guiding them to evidence that Elian discovered financial fraud before his death — fraud still operating under new names. Theo, feeling excluded, nearly reports them. Dominic lies to protect the secret for the first time. Emotional beat: guilt; justice beginning to cost him things he values.

chapters.title: Found Family, Fractured Trust
chapters.summary: Marisol's POV. Marisol confronts her father and is disowned in all but name; she moves into the dorms with Dominic and Theo, forming a fragile trio. The ghost leaves a fourth note addressed to all three — it has been watching them. Emotional beat: warmth of found family shadowed by the knowledge that trust can be weaponized.

chapters.title: Crane's Bargain
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Headmaster Crane offers Dominic a full-ride university placement in exchange for surrendering everything he's found. Dominic recognizes his own name appearing in the modern fraud ledgers — students are currency. He refuses, and his scholarship is flagged for review. Emotional beat: love against duty crystallizes; the safe path dies.

chapters.title: The Night of Long Corridors
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Caught breaking into the administration wing to copy the master ledger, the trio is separated by security. Theo, the skeptic, finally sees the ghost's ink writing itself before his eyes. Marisol is detained; Dominic escapes with half the evidence. Emotional beat: terror and loyalty fused; no one can pretend this is a game anymore.

chapters.title: Graduation Day
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. With Marisol released but watched, Dominic triggers their plan during commencement: the ledger streams to every family screen while the ghost's final note appears projected above the stage, naming Elian Marsh aloud. The board fractures publicly; Crane is arrested mid-ceremony. Emotional beat: triumphant catharsis earned through real sacrifice.

chapters.title: The Last Page of Ink
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV, closing with a letter from the ghost. In the emptied archive, an elderly former registrar — Elian's classmate and lifelong secret keeper — reveals herself as the hand behind the notes. She gives Dominic Elian's restored diploma and finally signs off. Dominic, Marisol, and Theo leave Ashgrove together, no longer invisible. Emotional beat: quiet peace; justice delivered outside the law, family chosen over safety.
